# Case Submission Guide

> **Who can use this feature?**
>
> **User type:** Both [Personal](https://www.opswat.com/docs/my/get-started/user-types-in-my-opswat-portal#personal-user) and [Organization](https://www.opswat.com/docs/my/get-started/user-types-in-my-opswat-portal#organization-user) users

If the AI Support Assistant doesn’t fully resolve your issue, you can easily escalate the conversation by submitting a case. This section walks you through how to create a support case in the My OPSWAT Portal.

> **Tip**
>
> You can always start by asking the AI assistant. If your issue can’t be solved through documentation or quick guidance, the assistant will guide you to submit a case.

Once you're ready to escalate an issue, click **Submit Case**. A guided form will open.

![](https://uploads.developerhub.io/prod/JYvy/e5x3ebbjwc79dparh4jmu4apbdmnwyunpt4ufzncvuo9q1242pf2ni93fgpo63in.png)

> **Please note**
>
> If you're a partner and would like to log a case on behalf of your customer, please refer to this guide: [Log a Case on Behalf of a Customer](https://www.opswat.com/docs/my/partner-guide/support-for-partners#log-a-case-on-behalf-of-a-customer)

| Step | Field | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ---- |
| 1 | Product | Choose the affected OPSWAT product. Click **More** to view the full product list. ![](https://uploads.developerhub.io/prod/JYvy/1osa7znsw9vagqmz253l5far26uei1tbg8hhxsbjc5ydloelg84c3lgab2erjkd3.png) |
| 2 | Platform (if applicable) | If the product supports multiple platforms, you’ll be prompted to select one (e.g., Windows, Linux). ![](https://uploads.developerhub.io/prod/JYvy/g5uog0arzu3eh8d97j7asul9ffa4msy76h1po0j4tabks458lta49doaolas6rk7.png) |
| 3 | Issue Type | Choose the nature of your issue, such as configuration, installation, or unexpected behavior, ensuring clear and consistent reporting. ![](https://uploads.developerhub.io/prod/JYvy/uijs82offk4ndsc9423a8aesoew2szts9q7dv7m3yelfid05kgh8z93j9naohvv1.png) |
| 4 | Severity | Indicate how critical the issue is ![](https://uploads.developerhub.io/prod/JYvy/xhpy3zxauu21ew2nra36kl0374wcpu1bh43as3542ml3eupoajm6ol3hv4s42vns.png) NoteBased on your org's support level and severity, you'll see an estimated initial response time. |
| 5 | Add License & Version | Select the license key and product version using dropdowns, or enter manually. |
| 6 | Subject & description | Provide a: - **Subject –** short, clear title (max 255 characters) - **Description** – detailed explanation of the issue (max 5000 characters) ![](https://uploads.developerhub.io/prod/JYvy/9q2n7z019dz1sp3iud9mu6ar8nwg5r5z7hexlboh9uoawwao0pcps4hv3kh1m9cv.png) |
| 7 | Review AI Suggestions (If Any) | Before submission, the AI assistant may suggest relevant knowledge base articles based on your input. If no relevant articles are found, users are directed to the next step. ![](https://uploads.developerhub.io/prod/JYvy/xsrhp9np7lj34yyxq60gevxl277zwggrh02b9d6ai46dfm87l4dn8pa6rxsllyr3.png)You then can decide to choose **I resolved the issue** or **Continue to Submit Case** Note If [AI Assistance](https://www.opswat.com/docs/my/my-organization/security#ai-assistance) is disabled, this step is skipped. |
| 8 | Upload Supporting Files | You can attach up to 5 files with a maximum total upload size of 2 GB. Note  To upload files larger than 2 GB, go to the [Case Details](https://www.opswat.com/docs/my/support-services/support-case-management#case-details) page and use the *Files & CC’s* tab after the case is submitted. ![](https://uploads.developerhub.io/prod/JYvy/xrmuj8uxizasdcmat6p0tjtgghmbo52b9m9vq6gg80lqyzccs0ryt0v6eqfj7m2f.png) |
| 9 | Confirmation | After submitting all supporting files, you will be directed to a final screen displaying a list of successfully uploaded files. ![](https://uploads.developerhub.io/prod/JYvy/bsa6inwobxy253i05w7our11wee7eefofeb7ygbweawm2893rezddeh72kx052lg.png) You can now monitor and manage your case under the **Case summary list** section. |

You can then manage the case from [Support Case Management](https://www.opswat.com/docs/my/support-services/support-case-management)

#### **Submitting an OPSWAT Academy support case**

![](data:image/png;base64,)

OPSWAT Academy learners can submit and track Academy support cases in My OPSWAT Portal

1. Go to **Support** and click **Submit A Case**. You can also start from the **Need help?** link on the Academy Overview tab, which opens the form with the product already set to OPSWAT Academy.
2. At the **Product Selection** step, choose **OPSWAT Academy**.
3. Choose an Academy issue type (for example: Account Access, Courses Enrollment, Payment Issues, Badge & Certification Issues, CPE Credits, or Other).
4. Complete the remaining fields and submit.

Academy cases appear in your case lists and support comments, escalation, and follow-up, just like other support cases.
